payload.artist_html: S. N. F. Spiekman & N. Klein
payload.credit_html: "An enigmatic lower jaw from the Lower Muschelkalk (Anisian, Middle Triassic) of Winterswijk provides insights into dental configuration, tooth replacement and histology"
payload.description_html: B) The holotype of Lamprosauroides goepperti, a right maxilla (MGU Wr 3871s) from Krappitz in Upper Silesia, in lateral view. C) Close-up of the two posteriormost preserved teeth (6th and 7th counted from anterior) of MGU Wr 3871s. D) Close-up of the enlarged fang (3rd counted from anterior) of MGU Wr 3871s. E) A left maxilla (GPIT-PV-31630) in lateral view referable to Lamprosauroides goepperti from Gogolin in Upper Silesia. The image of GPIT-PV-31630 was kindly provided by Agnes Fatz (GPIT) and has been mirrored for direct comparison with the holotype.
